dis.funding.form.title: Prepare a batch of funding figures
dis.funding.form.asOf.hint: The figure is read from this day on
dis.funding.form.adjusts.hint: The adjustment is booked in the open period and points at the locked month
dis.funding.form.amounts.mustSum: This pack asks for every period, adding up to the year plan in force.
dis.funding.form.explanation.hint: 20 to 2000 characters; required for a negative figure and for a late adjustment
dis.funding.form.makerChecker: The preparer does not accept: somebody else must accept the batch.
dis.funding.field.amounts: Enter whole-dong amounts for the periods (the whole set when the pack asks for it).
dis.funding.field.adjusts: Choose the year and the month that is corrected.
dis.funding.field.decision: Enter the decision document of the adjustment.
dis.funding.problem.locked: The period is locked: no new estimate or actual is accepted.
dis.funding.problem.afterActual: The period already has its actual or is soft-closed: no more estimates.
dis.funding.problem.phasing: The four quarters do not add up to the year plan in force.
dis.funding.problem.grain: The three months do not add up to the quarter.
dis.funding.problem.class: The class or tier is not one of the pack in force.
dis.funding.problem.conflict: The batch changed since you opened it; reload and try again.
dis.funding.problem.state: The batch is no longer in a state that allows this.
dis.funding.problem.self: The preparer does not accept or return his own batch.
dis.funding.problem.explanation: A negative figure needs an explanation of 20 characters.
dis.funding.problem.general: This could not be done; try again later.

dis.funding.conversion.periodActualIn: The actual of the period came in
dis.funding.conversion.correctionInOpenP: Correction of the actual in the open period
dis.funding.basis.official: Official figure (accepted report until reconciled, the books at the year end)
dis.funding.basis.treasury: Treasury payments from the start of the year to the cutoff
dis.funding.kind.planYear: Year plan (a measure other than disbursed)
dis.funding.kind.planAdjusted: Adjusted year plan (a measure other than disbursed)
dis.funding.reason.zeroDenominator: No denominator (the plan is zero or not published)
dis.funding.formula.planYear: The year plan of the first publication; it never changes after publication
dis.funding.formula.planAdjusted: The year plan of the publication in force when it is not the first; each adjustment replaces the plan in full and carries its decision
dis.funding.formula.planAdjustmentDelta: Adjusted year plan less the original year plan
dis.funding.formula.planInForce: The year plan of the adjustment in force on the day, otherwise the original
dis.funding.formula.planPeriod: The plan of the same level as the period: month, quarter (or the sum of its months) or the year in force
dis.funding.formula.planToDate: The sum of the phased month plans up to the end of the period
dis.funding.formula.estimate: The latest estimate effective on or before the day, only while the period has no actual
dis.funding.formula.estimateAsReported: The last estimate not after the end of the period; later estimates do not move it
dis.funding.formula.actual: The official actual of the period: the accepted report until reconciled, the books of a closed year
dis.funding.figure.cumulativeYtd: Cumulative from the start of the year
dis.funding.formula.cumulativeYtd: The sum of the actuals of the months from the start of the year to the end of the period; never summed across reports
dis.funding.figure.cumulativeSinceStart: Cumulative since the start of the project
dis.funding.formula.cumulativeSinceStart: The opening balance plus the actual of every month from the first period to the end of the period
dis.funding.formula.estimateYear: The actual of the months that have one plus the estimate or the plan of the others; a month with none gives no figure
dis.funding.formula.remainingYear: The plan in force less the cumulative; a negative figure is over plan and is shown
dis.funding.formula.conversionDelta: The actual of the period less the estimate as reported of the period
dis.funding.figure.ratePm: Disbursement rate on the plan given
dis.funding.formula.ratePm: What the Treasury paid from 1 January to the cutoff over the year plan given by the Prime Minister, times 100
dis.funding.figure.rateTotal: Disbursement rate on the whole plan
dis.funding.formula.rateTotal: What the Treasury paid over the whole year plan in force with what was added, times 100
dis.funding.formula.rateCarryover: What was reported of the carried-over capital over its own plan, times 100; never mixed with the year plan
dis.funding.formula.rateYearInForce: The cumulative from the start of the year over the year plan in force, times 100, for each measure
dis.funding.formula.rateYearOriginal: The cumulative over the original year plan, times 100; it shows what the adjustments did
dis.funding.formula.ratePeriod: The actual of the period over the plan of the same level, times 100; none when the plan is not phased
dis.funding.formula.rateYtdPhased: The cumulative over the sum of the phased plan to the end of the period, times 100; pace, not completion
dis.funding.formula.rateOutlookYear: The estimate of the year over the year plan in force, times 100
dis.funding.formula.rateSinceStart: The cumulative since the start of the project over the total investment in force, times 100
dis.funding.formula.estimateAccuracy: The actual of the period over the estimate as reported, times 100
dis.funding.formula.structureShare: The cumulative of one class over the sum of the additive classes of the same scope, times 100
dis.funding.term.cumulativeYtd: The cumulative from the start of the year
dis.funding.term.cumulativeSinceStart: The cumulative since the start of the project
dis.funding.term.planInForcePrimary: The year plan given (without what was added)
dis.funding.term.classSum: The sum of the additive classes
dis.funding.term.treasuryYtd: What the Treasury paid from the start of the year
